# What hourly rate does a contract need to pay to match your salary offer?

> Free W-2 to 1099 rate calculator: find the hourly contract rate that matches a salaried offer after self-employment tax, health insurance, unpaid time off, bench time, lost 401(k) match and expenses. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
